'''Hellhounds''' in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] are troops fighting for [[Zamorak]] against armies of the other gods. They are stronger than the regular [[hellhound]] and can be killed for [[killcount]].

==Trivia==
* After the [[Update:Ring of Wealth, Shanties, Trolls and Dungeoneering|ring of wealth update]] on [[16 March]] [[2011]], the charm drop rates of hellhounds and [[rock lobster]]s had "gone walkabouts."{{CiteForum|author = Mod Sneakman|url = http://services.runescape.com/m=forum/forums.ws?15,16,525,62549891,goto,2|archivedate=18 March 2013|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/5765954|title = Hellhounds Nerf?|forum = Recent Updates|postdate = 16 March 2011|notes = }} This caused hellhounds to drop gold charms less frequently. Rather, they seemed to drop blue charms much more often. This was, however, fixed on 28 March as noted in the [[Update:Patch Notes (28 March 2011)|patch notes]] of that date.
